messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: High volume of KMS decrypt failures detected for service=runtime-api, env=prod. Triggering P1 alert. PD incident: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PDI-87234 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: Incident PDI-87234 created (triggered by auto-alert). Acknowledge to start oncall workflow.

alex-nguyen: acked. I'm on it, standing up console access and pulling logs.

oncall-rotation: handoff note: i'm approx 10m out, alex is primary until then. escalate if customer impact > 10% 10m window.

mike-sre: logs show repeated KMS errors: "DecryptError: KeyNotFound: key arn:aws:kms:...:alias/redwood-rotate-2026 not found" and lots of 429s from hsm-proxy afterwards. stack traces attached in log: ```
2026-03-14T21:15:02Z ERROR runtime-api decrypt failed keyId=alias/redwood-rotate-2026 error=KeyNotFound
2026-03-14T21:15:03Z WARN runtime-api retrying decrypt attempt=1
2026-03-14T21:15:04Z ERROR hsm-proxy 429 Too Many Requests
```

sara-platform: interesting — that alias is from last night's key rotation job. Did the rotation job complete successfully? cc @robin-cs to see if any customer-facing changes.

robin-cs: saw a small bump in CS tickets: "feature blocked — returns 500 when saving secrets". We'll hold customer comms until we know blast radius.

alex-nguyen: quick summary of root candidate: rotation job created new key and updated alias, but the old worker fleet still tried to call the previous key ARN; for some requests the new key ARN wasn't found in HSM mapping, causing KeyNotFound. Then our retry storm hit HSM proxy and triggered throttling -> 429s causing additional downstream 503s.

priya-patel: ack. prioritize stop-the-bleeding options. Options: 1) roll back alias to previous key (fast in KMS) 2) enable fallback cache in runtime to use cached DEKs for short window 3) throttle retries in client to backoff and reduce hsm-proxy load. Who can make alias rollback call?

mike-sre: I can run alias rollback if engineering signs off. Need to confirm previous key ARN. alex, can you fetch rotation job metadata?

alex-nguyen: grabbing job metadata... ```
$ curl -s https://internal-rotate/api/jobs/1337 | jq '.steps[] | {keyArn, status}'
{ "keyArn": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111:key/old-key-aaa", "status": "active" }
{ "keyArn": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111:key/new-key-bbb", "status": "failed_publish" }
```

alex-nguyen: ok the job shows new-key publish step failed but alias was updated (race). That explains missing mapping. new-key-bbb isn't present in HSM backend.

priya-patel: rollback alias to old-key-aaa now. mike, if you can do it, go ahead and post PD notes. Also rate-limit client retries to reduce 429s.

mike-sre: doing alias change now. Command: ```
aws kms update-alias --alias-name alias/redwood-rotate-2026 --target-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111:key/old-key-aaa
```
... update succeeded. Waiting for propagation (should be < 10s).

incident-bot: Alias update detected for alias/redwood-rotate-2026. Propagation event logged.

alex-nguyen: monitoring decrypt success rates... baseline success 99.9% before alert, currently at 78%. After rollback success rate jumps to 95% in minutes. Seeing 429s tail off.

mike-sre: also pushed temporary client side retry limiter: reduce max_retries from 5 -> 2 and enable exponential backoff jitter for runtime-api, config: ```
runtime_api.retry.max_retries=2
runtime_api.retry.backoff=exponential
```
Rollout to edge nodes in progress.

priya-patel: good. action items: - Alias rollback done - Client retry limiter rolled out - Increase hsm-proxy capacity? (ops) - Deep root cause: rotation job should not update alias unless HSM publish succeeds. Create follow-up RFC.

sara-platform: can we confirm customer impact numbers for CS? robin, what % of requests hit errors at peak?

robin-cs: CS reported ~120 errors/hour from power users. From metrics alex posted, peak error rate was ~22% of decrypt calls for a 7m window.

alex-nguyen: posting short-term mitigation summary for PD notes: ```
- 21:15 UTC: Alert PDI-87234 triggered for increased KMS Decrypt failures and hsm-proxy 429s.
- 21:18 UTC: Identified alias rotation race: alias pointed to new key that failed to publish to HSM.
- 21:22 UTC: Rolled back alias to previous key (old-key-aaa). decrypt success recovered to 95% by 21:27 UTC.
- 21:30 UTC: Deployed client retry limiter to reduce retry storms.
- 21:40 UTC: 429s subsided, customer requests returned to normal.
```

pagerduty: Incident PDI-87234 acknowledged by alex-nguyen and assigned to mike-sre. Status: acknowledged -> monitoring.

priya-patel: follow-ups (owners): - rotation workflow hardening (owner: eng-ml) - HSM publish verification before alias flip (owner: eng-infra) - add automated smoke decrypt test immediately post-rotation (owner: eng-runtime) - postmortem doc (owner: oncall-rotation). Please add timelines.

mike-sre: I'll open a Jira for immediate infra fix to gate alias updates. QR: INFRA-7123. Also reach out to HSM vendor on quota/visibility.

robin-cs: customer comms draft: "We experienced partial decryption failures in prod due to an internal key rotation; we've reverted the rotation and services have recovered. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with postmortem." ok to send after triage?

priya-patel: ok to send a holding message. include timeframe and ETA for postmortem.

incident-bot: PD PDI-87234 status update: monitoring. Automatically closing after 24h if no regression.

alex-nguyen: closing note: monitoring for any regressions. Leaving this thread open for postmortem comments.

mike-sre: final: recommend adding a canary flag to rotation job to prevent alias change without successful HSM publish + add circuit breaker on client retries.

robin-cs: thx team, CS will hold off on wider customer emails until postmortem.

oncall-rotation: handoff: i'll document the incident timeline and take ownership of the postmortem write-up. dropping back to normal ops. :white_check_mark:
